title: Skandal Pensil Tajam
theme: Menjelajahi absurditas dan rutinitas monoton kehidupan kantor yang kadang membuat seseorang meragukan kewarasan diri sendiri.

cover.prompt: A finely crafted 0.5mm mechanical pencil, perfectly centered on a clean, smooth desk surface. Gentle, warm light catches its metallic details, emphasizing its precision and elegant design. The composition conveys a feeling of quiet contemplation and meticulous thought, with a softly blurred background hinting at an organized workspace. A subtle sense of potential and efficiency.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: Ari, an aging office worker obsessed with precision, descends into a paranoid investigation after his beloved mechanical pencil vanishes, replaced by a dull wooden one. His suspicions lead him to accuse a junior colleague of a 'pencil-swapping conspiracy,' only to discover a mundane explanation that highlights the absurdities of office life and his own dwindling sanity.
